questions.a: Restaurant reporting software turns the data your business generates every day into clear insight you can act on. It pulls sales, labor, inventory, food cost and guest data into one place. Good tools focus on the metrics that matter so you aren't wading through charts you don't need.

questions.q: What reports should a restaurant review regularly?
questions.a: Most operators check daily sales summaries, labor cost against sales and food cost or inventory variance. A P&L comparison across locations helps multi-unit groups spot underperforming stores. Guest feedback and review trends show where service or quality is slipping.

questions.q: What should I look for in restaurant reporting software?
questions.a: Look for multi-location roll-ups, scheduled reports that arrive automatically and integrations with your POS, payroll and accounting systems. Customizable dashboards let you drill down from a high-level view to a single location or daypart. Ease of use and responsive support matter too, since you'll want to customize reports over time.

questions.q: Is POS reporting enough for my restaurant?
questions.a: For many independent restaurants, the reporting built into a POS covers sales, menu mix and staff performance well. As you add locations, you may want dedicated tools for labor, food cost or accounting-grade P&L reports. Some platforms combine data from several systems into one dashboard.

questions.q: How can reporting software help reduce labor and food costs?
questions.a: Labor reports compare scheduled hours with sales so you can see where you're over or understaffed, and alert you to overtime. Food cost reports track inventory variance and recipe costs to show where margin leaks before month-end. Forecasting tools use sales history to plan staffing and prep.

questions.q: How do I report on guest experience across locations?
questions.a: Combine reviews, messages and guest feedback from every location into one view and compare locations side by side. Momos rolls up reputation and guest data across your portfolio, surfaces trends by location and turns guest sentiment into clear actions. Its Operational Insight Dashboards show where each restaurant is doing well and where it needs improvement.
